main_text.p: gări solet pecus, scribit R.Salom. Gen.30.40. Plur. עֲקֻדִּים Varios, Ibid. verf.39.
בֵּית־עֶקֶר[?] Beth-Heked, nomen proprium loci, à Ligatione sic dicti, quòd ibi Oves ad tonsuram ligare solerent, 2.Regum 10.12.
עֲקָה מַעֲקֶה m. Lorica, Loricatio, Petibolus, Septum tectorum, Deuter.22.8. Tecta enim in Palæstina fuerunt plana in ædificiis, unde munimento egebant, ne quis deciderent.
עָקַל מַעֲקֵל Perversum, Tortuosum, Obtortum, Abac.1.4. Est Participium ex Pyhal[?].
עַקְלְקְלוּת f.p. Tortuosa, Jud.5.6. Aff. עַקְלַקְלּוֹתָם In tortuosis viis suis, Psal.125.5.

עָקַר Exstirpavit, Eradicavit, Enervavit. Infinit. עֵת לַעֲקֹר Tempus exstirpandi, Eccles.3.2. Niph. Futur. תֵּעָקֵר Exstirpabitur, Soph.2. v.4. Pih. אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם עִקֵּר Equos ipsorum enervavit: Suffragines succidit, Jos.11. v.9. עָקְרוּ שׁוֹר[?] Exstirparunt, Avulserunt murum; juxta Ab. Esr. Gen.49.6. Futurum; וַיְעַקֵּר Et enervavit, suffragines succidit; 1.Paral.18.4. תְּעַקֵּר Suffragines succides, Jos.11.6. Chald. Præterit. ex Ithpehal אִיתְעֲקַר Eradicata fuerunt; Daniel.7.8. Scribitur cum ı[?] ex forma pluralis masculini; sed legendum juxta Masorethas; אִתְעֲקָרָה ex forma fœmin.
עָקָר m. & Fœm. עֲקָרָה עֲקָרֶת Sterilis, Deuteron.7.14. Psal.113.9. ex quibus virtus pariendi Eradicata.
עָקָר m. Stirps, Indigena, qui è familia peregrina ortus, alibi radices egit, & stirpem fecit, Lev.25.47.
עֻקַּר m. Chal. Stirps, Radix, Fundamentum: עִקַּר שָׁרְשׁוֹהִי[?] Stirpem radicum ejus; Dan.4.12.

page.notes: Running head and catchword are Hebrew. Several Hebrew forms and the Hebrew-letter abbreviation "ı" after "cum" are doubtful and marked [?]. The printed "Pybal" is read as "Pyhal" and marked [?]. Citation "Iof." is read as Jos. after the i/j rule. Watermark "Digitized by Google" at bottom right is excluded.
